name: EIC Accelerator
summary: Grant and or equity for high-risk, high-potential SMEs and startups with breakthrough innovation. Natural persons may apply intending to set up an SME.
amount: Grant below EUR 2.5 million, and or equity of EUR 1 million to EUR 10 million, in grant-only, blended or equity-only options

deadline.note: Full proposal cut-offs in 2026: 7 Jan, 4 Mar, 6 May, 8 Jul, 2 Sep and 4 Nov (17:00 Brussels). Short proposals any time

next_steps: Read the official EIC Accelerator page and check the eligibility rules
Prepare a short proposal, which can be submitted at any time
Form an EU company before the full proposal stage if required

name: EIT Digital Venture Incubation Program (28DIGITAL)
provider: EIT Digital, part of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT)
summary: A 12-week incubation for early-stage digital startups led by multidisciplinary teams, with a cash prize and a Demo Day.
amount: EUR 5,000 Growth Package prize at stage 1; stage 2 up to EUR 25,000 (see official page)

deadline.note: Yearly call. The 2026 call closed 9 June 2026 at 17:00 CET

next_steps: Watch the official page for the next yearly call
Form a team of at least two members
Check the incorporation date rule for the call

name: Erasmus for Young Entrepreneurs
provider: European Commission, Erasmus for Young Entrepreneurs programme
summary: A funded exchange in which a new or recently started entrepreneur works with an experienced entrepreneur running an SME in another participating country.
amount: Monthly travel and living support for a 1 to 6 month exchange; no fees to take part. Amounts: see official page
next_steps: Check the official page for the participating countries and eligibility
Plan a host entrepreneur match in a participating country

name: EuroHPC AI Factories (access for SMEs and startups)
summary: Free customised support and access to EU AI computing for SMEs and startups, through the EU AI Factories network.
amount: Free access and support, value varies. See official page
next_steps: Read the access routes on the official page
Contact the AI Factories helpdesk to check establishment requirements
Describe the AI model work you need
